title: LEVOIT Air Purifier Core 300 Review: What I Would Check Before Buying
meta_description: The Core 300 is a compact, quiet HEPA unit for small rooms. It lacks smart features and has a modest filter size, but it delivers solid air cleaning on a tight budget.
